class.name: NetwInterestLayer
class.brief_description: A group of entities and the peers that can see them.
class.description:
The server adds [member entities] and [member viewers] to a layer, and [member policy] decides which peers see the entities. Two [NetwInterestLayer] objects with the same [member layer_id] are the same layer. Clients only learn what they can see. [codeblock] # server var sight := Netw.of(self).interest_layer(&"sight") sight.add_entity(target_entity) sight.add_viewer(observer_peer_id)
# client var sight := Netw.of(self).interest_layer(&"sight") sight.entity_visible.connect(func(entity): add_marker(entity.owner) ) [/codeblock] Changes apply at the end of the frame, or at [method NetwMultiplayer.interest_flush_now]. On the server, use [signal interest_enter] and [signal interest_exit]. On a client, use [signal entity_visible] and [signal entity_hidden]. An entity inside a multiplayer scene is only visible to peers in that scene, whatever other layers say.

method.name: add_entity
method.description: Adds [param entity] to the layer. Returns [code]false[/code] when it was already in it. [b]Server Only.[/b]

method.name: add_viewer
method.description: Adds [param peer_id] to [member viewers]. Returns [code]false[/code] when it already was. [param peer_id] must not be [code]0[/code].

method.name: apply_server_transition
method.description: Emits [signal interest_enter] or [signal interest_exit], then the entity's own signals and callbacks. The session calls it. Calling it yourself emits a change that did not happen. [b]Server Only.[/b]

method.name: client_admit
method.description: Marks [param entity] as visible to this client and emits [signal entity_visible]. The session calls it.

method.name: client_revoke
method.description: Marks [param entity] as no longer visible to this client and emits [signal entity_hidden]. The session calls it.

method.name: client_untrack_entity
method.description: Removes [param entity] on a client when it leaves the tree, emitting [signal entity_removed] and then [signal entity_hidden]. The session calls it.

method.name: debug_dump
method.description: Returns the state of this layer and why [param peer_id] can or cannot see it. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴layer_id String this layer ┠╴policy int a LayerPolicy value ┠╴viewers Array the viewer peer ids ┠╴entities int number of entities ┠╴peer_id int the peer asked about ┠╴verdict bool what verdict_for returns for that peer ┖╴explanation String the reason, for reading [/codeblock]

method.name: has_entity
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [param entity] is in the layer. Use [method is_visible_to] to ask who sees it.

method.name: has_viewer
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [param peer_id] is in [member viewers]. With [constant NetwMultiplayer.LAYER_POLICY_HIDE_FROM_INSIDERS], viewers are the peers that cannot see.

method.name: is_visible_to
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [param peer_id] can see [param entity], considering every layer. A client can only ask about itself.

method.name: monitor_snapshot
method.description: Returns counts for this layer. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴viewers int number of viewers ┠╴entities int number of entities ┠╴visible_edges int (entity, peer) pairs that can see each other ┖╴transitions_total int shows plus hides since the layer was created [/codeblock]

method.name: remove_entity
method.description: Removes [param entity] from the layer. Returns [code]false[/code] when it was not in it. [b]Server Only.[/b]

method.name: remove_viewer
method.description: Removes [param peer_id] from [member viewers]. Returns [code]false[/code] when it was not a viewer.

method.name: set_policy
method.description: Sets [member policy]. Returns [code]false[/code] when it did not change.

method.name: verdict_for
method.description: Returns whether this layer alone lets [param peer_id] see its entities. Use [method is_visible_to] for the full answer.

members.member: What happens to a peer's copy of an entity it stops seeing, unless the entity sets its own.
Whether a kept copy is still shown after the peer stops seeing it, unless the entity sets its own.
The entities in the layer, as keys. On a client, only the ones it sees. Returns a copy, so use [method add_entity] and [method remove_entity] to change it.
Whether [member viewers] are the peers that see the entities, or the ones that do not.
The viewer peer ids, as keys. Returns a copy, so use [method add_viewer] and [method remove_viewer] to change it.

signal.name: entity_added
signal.description: Emitted when [param entity] is added to the layer.

signal.name: entity_hidden
signal.description: Emitted on a client when it stops seeing [param entity] through this layer.

signal.name: entity_removed
signal.description: Emitted when [param entity] is removed from the layer.

signal.name: entity_visible
signal.description: Emitted on a client when it starts seeing [param entity] through this layer.

signal.name: interest_enter
signal.description: Emitted on the server when [param peer_id] starts seeing [param entity] through this layer.

signal.name: interest_exit
signal.description: Emitted on the server when [param peer_id] stops seeing [param entity] through this layer.

signal.name: viewer_added
signal.description: Emitted when [param peer_id] is added to [member viewers].

signal.name: viewer_removed
signal.description: Emitted when [param peer_id] is removed from [member viewers].
